rail_end_attachment.center_method: Midpoint of opposed planar arms at X=11.930343627929688 and 17.9307861328125; Y=5.753509521484375 and 7.753662109375. This is an inferred design center of the open star-shaped recess, not a fitted circle or declared CAD datum.
rail_end_attachment.shape: open star/cross recess, not a circular drilled hole

proposed_registration.condition: Set target axis center worldY/worldZ from the applicable side-fixer source hole center. Rail center worldX=0. Source Y=max lip should face outside of each mounting row.
proposed_registration.matrix_target_note: Matrices place rail attachment axis at worldY=0, worldZ=0. Add targetY to matrix[1][3], targetZ to matrix[2][3]. Rotations both have determinant +1. Row pitch and row Z are controlled by actual fixer data and are not encoded here.
